vetSays.line: 🛡️ Avery, Autumn, Nthabiseng, Aud and Omar met them at the door — 4 put down. Autumn didn't come back. Avery, Nthabiseng, Aud, Omar are hurt.
🛡️ Avery, Nthabiseng, Aud, Omar and Owen met them at the door — 5 put down. Avery, Nthabiseng, Aud, Omar, Owen are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Avery just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Nthabiseng, Aud, Owen and Sofia met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Nthabiseng, Aud, Owen, Sofia are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Owen just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Omar just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Nthabiseng, Aud, Omar, Owen and Sofia met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Aud, Omar, Owen, Sofia are hurt.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Vasyl just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Wanjiru just put down The Congregation... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Elif was watching. Now they know European Elder too.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: European Elder — named and noted.
Wanjiru showed Vasyl the European Elder — "remember it." Word travels before the lesson cools.
Vito showed Avery the European Elder — "remember it." Word gets around.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
Aud showed Owen the European Elder — "remember it." The haven hears about it by supper.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

⚠️ 1 threats: Pack-leader Ugly-Eyes (×2) — all here, all now.
Your party: just you. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
The Pack-leader Ugly-Eyes falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Pack-leader Ugly-Eyes!
🛡️ Sam met them at the door — 1 put down.
📓 Codex: A woman, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek — jotted down what they said. Filed.
